Definition: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have a vision of
BiblicalUsage: To see is to perceive with understanding, and the word is used for seeing men and seeing God. Jethro tells Moses to provide able men who fear God, the nobles of Israel see God and eat and drink, and Amos writes the words he saw concerning Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe seeing in the Bible is never only with the eyes: the nobles see God and live, and the prophet sees a word before he speaks it. God shows Himself to those He calls.
